rules: Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

goblin-bomber.name: Bare Knuckle Lunatic
goblin-bomber.story: Brawler who thinks every problem is a fistfight. Always bouncing, always throwing punches.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Shadow boxing (owner's wish): bouncing on his toes, bob and weave, jab-jab-cross combination, then back to bouncing. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: boxer's shuffle, fists up guarding his face, shoulders rolling.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Three-punch combo: left jab, left jab, then a huge wind-up right haymaker. The haymaker connects at the 'hit' event.

B.name: OH_Death
B.description: His death ability: knocked to one knee, raises his right fist high and SLAMS it into the ground (event 'shockwave' at the moment of impact - the game sends the knock-back wave), then collapses forward and stays down (do not return to idle).

goblin-scrapper.name: Bowler Brawler
goblin-scrapper.holds: a bowling ball in his right hand (held out in front of him)
goblin-scrapper.story: Ex-professional goblin bowler. Cocky, plays to the crowd, loves his ball.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Spins the bowling ball on one raised finger like a basketball for a moment, then catches it and holds it in front of him again, looking smug. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: confident strut, ball cradled at his hip.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Shoulder-check bash: steps in and slams the target with the ball held in both hands. Impact at 'hit'.

B.name: OH_Special
B.description: Bowling roll (owner's wish): brings the ball back behind him, steps forward low into a classic bowler's lunge, swings the arm forward and releases the ball along the ground in front of him ('ball_release' at the release), follow-through with the arm up, then a little fist pump.

goblin-sneak.name: Backstabbing Thief
goblin-sneak.holds: a dagger in his right hand and a bag at his neck
goblin-sneak.story: Sneaky and sinister, hides in shadows before he strikes. Never fights fair.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Hunched and shifty: tests the dagger point with a fingertip, glances left and right, a little twirl of the dagger, then back to a crouched ready stance. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: sneaking tiptoe, crouched low, dagger held close.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Backstab: quick sidestep as if slipping behind the target, then a clean double stab forward and down (two stabs, 'hit' at the second), then hops back into his crouch.

junk-shaman.name: Junk Shaman
junk-shaman.holds: a staff in his right hand
junk-shaman.story: Old, wise goblin spellcaster. Leans on his staff, mutters spells.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Leans on his staff, taps it on the ground twice, mutters (head bobbing), free hand wiggles fingers like stirring magic. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: slow old-man hobble using the staff as a walking stick.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Bonks the target with the top of his staff: raise high, bring it down. 'hit' at contact.

B.name: OH_Special
B.description: Levitation spell: raises the staff high overhead with his free hand reaching out, fingers spread ('lift_start' when the arm is fully raised - the game lifts the target), holds while slowly moving the arm sideways as if carrying something heavy through the air, then lowers the staff ('lift_end' - the game sets the target down).

goblin-slinger.name: Skullflinger
goblin-slinger.holds: a skull mace in his right hand
goblin-slinger.story: Throws skulls of fallen enemies. Gleeful and twitchy. His attack (Skull_Throw) is already made and approved.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Tosses a skull up a little and catches it in the same hand, looks around eagerly for a target, cackles (shoulders shaking). Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: bouncy, eager skip-walk, skull held up by his shoulder.

goblin-grunt.name: Snotskull Grunt
goblin-grunt.holds: a frying pan in his right hand
goblin-grunt.story: Plain and sturdy, not very smart, but can still hurt ya.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Dim-witted: picks his nose with the free hand, looks at it, wipes it on his shirt, rests the frying pan on his shoulder. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: heavy, plodding march, pan on his shoulder.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Big overhead frying-pan whack: two-handed raise, slam down with a squash on contact ('hit').

goblin-pebbler.name: Boneknocker
goblin-pebbler.holds: a spiked club in his right hand
goblin-pebbler.story: Plain and sturdy. Just kneecaps! Low, mean swings.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Slaps the club into his free palm, grins, rolls his neck. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: swaggering stomp, club dragging low behind him (never through the ground).

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Kneecapper: crouches and swings the club low and sideways at knee height ('hit' at contact), then straightens up laughing.

rotgut-grenadier.name: Goblin Chef
rotgut-grenadier.holds: a spatula in his right hand
rotgut-grenadier.story: Not very clean, not very nice, cooks horribly. His smack knocks the target back 2 spaces.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Flips something invisible with the spatula, catches it, sniffs it, makes a disgusted-but-proud face. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: waddling cook's shuffle, belly forward, spatula waving.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Smack: huge sideways spatula swat, like hitting a fly, with a big follow-through ('hit' at contact; the game knocks the target back 2 spaces).

skullbasher-rusher.name: Skullbasher Rusher
skullbasher-rusher.holds: a mace in his right hand and a shield in his left hand
skullbasher-rusher.story: Charge! Moves and attacks in the same turn. All forward momentum.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Bangs the mace on his shield twice, stamps a foot like a bull ready to charge, snorts. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: leaning-forward jog with the shield up in front.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Shield bash then mace swing: lunges forward behind the shield (first impact), then swings the mace down ('hit' at the mace impact).

shiv-rat.name: Shiv Rat
shiv-rat.holds: a dagger in his right hand and a backpack on his back
shiv-rat.story: Small, twitchy, sneaky. Enemies can't strike back. Darts in and out.

A.name: OH_Idle
A.description: Twitchy rat-like movements: quick head turns, sniffing, flicks the dagger, shifts weight foot to foot. Loops.

A.name: OH_Walk
A.description: In-place walk cycle for moving one board space at a time (the game slides him forward; he must NOT move forward himself, feet step in place like on a treadmill). Two full steps, loops seamlessly. Style: quick scurry with small fast steps, hunched.

B.name: OH_Attack
B.description: Darting shiv: quick lunge in, three fast stabs ('hit' at the last), then a hop back.

R1.name: OH_Hit
R1.description: Takes a normal hit: head and chest snap back, one stagger step, shakes it off and returns to idle.

R1.name: OH_React_Knockback
R1.description: Shoved hard: arms fly up, upper body thrown backwards, skids (the game slides him back 1-2 spaces - he must not travel himself), windmills his arms and catches his balance.

R1.name: OH_React_Bonk
R1.description: Bonked on the head by a thrown skull: head snaps down, eyes-crossed dizzy wobble in a circle, shakes head and recovers.

R2.name: OH_React_Bowled
R2.description: Hit by a giant bowling ball like a bowling pin: legs swept, falls flat on his back ('down' event when he hits the ground), lies dazed a moment, then gets up holding his head ('up' event when standing) and returns to idle.

R2.name: OH_React_Backstab
R2.description: Stabbed in the back: arches forward with a jolt ('hit' at the jolt), stiff arms, then reaches back over his shoulder trying to pull out the dagger, finally yanks it free and staggers back to idle.

R2.name: OH_React_Lifted
R2.description: Lifted into the air by magic (the game raises and moves him; he must stay in place): legs dangle and kick, arms flail, struggles. Loops seamlessly while he floats.
